config_pending: Change will take effect in a new session
cmd_help_text:
/lang			Set target language
  /source		Set source language (or 'auto' for detection)
  /model		Change main translation model
  /fast			Change fast model (for language/context detection)
  /prov			Change API provider
  /show			Show current configuration
  /switch		Swap source and target languages
  /clear		Reset translation session
  /usage		Show token usage and cost estimate
  /history		View translation history
  /bye			Exit
  /?, /help		Show this help

  Use """ to begin a multi-line message.
no_reasoning: (Model does not support reasoning or thinking is off.)
config_reverted: Config reverted to last valid version.
set_source_first: Set a source language first with /source.
not_valid_bool: not a valid boolean. Use true/false.
could_not_fetch_models: Could not fetch model list. Enter model name directly.
help_lang:
Set the target language for translation.

  /lang          Open interactive language selector
help_source:
Set or auto-detect the source language.

  /source        Open interactive selector
  /source auto   Enable automatic detection
help_model:
Change the main translation model.

  /model         List available models and select
help_fast:
Change the fast model used for language/context detection.

  /fast          List available models and select
help_prov:
Change the API provider and authenticate.

  /prov          Open provider selector and API key prompt
help_config:
Manage configuration.

  /config show           View config via less
  /config edit           Edit config in $EDITOR
  /config <key> <value>  Set a config option directly
help_history:
View or clear translation history.

  /history       Browse past sessions
  /history clear Clear all history
help_switch: Swap source and target languages. Requires manually specified source language.
help_usage: Show token usage and cost estimate.
help_help: List all available commands. Use /<cmd> ? for detailed help on a specific command.
config_usage:
Usage:
  /config show           View config via less
  /config edit           Edit config in $EDITOR
  /config <key> <value>  Set a config option directly
